notes:
Summary: HelixCare Docsight is building an enterprise clinical-document search platform for hospitals and large provider groups. Primary goal: high-quality RAG for clinical notes + PDFs with strict PHI controls. They need embeddings + reranker pipeline that scales to tens of millions of documents, sub-300ms P95 query latency for prioritized routes, and predictable cost per query (< $0.005 target for core queries).

Key quotes: "Must be auditable down to token-level and retain immutable access logs for 7+ years." — Head of Infosec. "We need reranker to resolve near-duplicate notes and surface the most actionable snippet — clinical workflows can't wait." — Product lead.

Technical constraints: indexing target 25M docs initially, steady-state ingest 500k docs/month, average doc length 3k tokens, embedding dimension preference 1536 or 1024 (open to quantized vectors). Primary query pattern: 15k–25k q/day peak, bursts up to 40q/sec during rounds. Latency SLO: P95 <= 300ms for search+rerank; P50 <= 120ms. Cost sensitivity high (non-profit hospital margins), willingness to trade latency for batching strategies if SLO maintained. PHI controls: customer requires VPC or on-prem, KMS integration, immutable audit logs, SAML SSO, data residency in NA, strict retention rules.

POC ask: ingest 100k representative docs, run embedding + ANN index evaluation (recall@5, latency), run reranker tests against labeled queries (A/B vs current BM25 baseline). Security: needs SOC2 Type II and ISO27001 attestation + sample audit logs. They asked for a network diagram with egress rules and key rollover process.
